categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and cleans up Boost Test assertion macros in unit tests to assist the test runner migration.
categories.rationale: Replaces infrequently used `BOOST_FAIL` macros with `REQUIRE` checks and adds context strings to descriptor tests in preparation for transitioning test runners (#35713). This is minor test cleanup that has minimal impact on framework signal, test coverage, or runtime.
